name: Admits Identity
description: A delegated-join token admits an external workload identity named in one of its allow rules: an AWS account or IAM role ARN, a GitHub repository or workflow, a Kubernetes service account, a GitLab project. Target open because the identity lives in whatever plugin models that platform; the rule itself is carried as a property.

rule.description: The allow rule (as written in the token's spec.allow) that names this identity.
